notes.title: Embrace the love in the new heart-warming Fuddler’s Courtship DLC - out now!
notes.content:
Dear travelers,

Are you ready for a journey of the heart? Snufkin and friends are set for a new romance-infused adventure in the novella-like [b]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler’s Courtship[/b] expansion, out today on Steam and consoles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875880/Snufkin_Melody_of_Moominvalley__Fuddlers_Courtship/

Join Snufkin and his best friend, Moomintroll, as they embark on a camping trip deep into the wilds before winter in [b]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler’s Courtship[/b]. 

However, what should have been a relaxing excursion turns into a chaotic journey of romance and adventure. 

Many new and old friends are set to appear, not in the least shy but charming Fuddler, who desperately needs help navigating a blossoming romance among the falling leaves of autumn. 

[previewyoutube=udehdvpGttI;full][/previewyoutube]

In the very first expansion of the popular [b]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley[/b], embrace the love amongst the striking watercolor visuals of autumn in this brand-new pocket-sized heart-warming musical adventure. 

[list]
[*][b]Gone camping:[/b] Once again, Moominvalley’s friends and family find themselves in need of Snufkin and his best pal, Moomintroll. Head out on this love-filled adventure with a cast of your favorite characters, and make new friends on a journey sprinkled with puzzles, surprises, and enchanting musical notes.
[*][b]Pushing the right buttons:[/b] Meet the charming yet shy Fuddler and help him on a journey of the heart, exploring the complexities of love and romance as he courts Mymble, Little My’s sister.
[*][b]Something’s in the air:[/b] Nature changes color as Moominvalley welcomes autumn in all its splendor. Witness the rich spectacle of nature beautifully recreated in this atmospheric [i]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley[/i] expansion. 
[/list]
[h2]💗Fuddler, Who? Feelings, Whaaa?!💗[/h2]

Love is as beautiful as a rose, but the path to winning your beloved’s heart can be thorny. That won’t stop the determined Fuddler from shyly fumbling his way down the path of romance in our Snufkin game’s new DLC, Fuddler’s Courtship. During a camping adventure, Snufkin and Moomintroll learn of the Fuddler’s affection for Mymble, and joyfully and chaotically set out to help Fuddler with his courtship.

Fuddler is a shy and sweet collector of buttons. He lives in a charming tin coffee can and wears a pan for a hat. Fuddler is not very good in voicing his feelings in front of his crush, Mymble, but tries his best to impress her. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/8ea1101a48bd41d40927bc8bcffcf5b25846db2b.png[/img]

Fuddler originally appears in the 1959 Moomin comic “Fuddler’s Courtship,” the story our DLC is inspired by, and it also similarly follows Fuddler’s misadventures in love. So how is he related to other Moomin characters? In our Snufkin game, you’ve met his brother Sniff, who is a bit fearful but also dearly loves his toy dog Cedric! Their father is Muddler, a scatterbrained and anxious fellow with a penchant for collecting. Sniff resembles their mother, Fuzzy, more and Fuddler takes after Muddler. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/d0e197ce2370b73b378064936bade0763c7dcfa5.png[/img]

When adapting this story we focused primarily on the Fuddler’s character and his sweet and clumsy way to go about finding love. As with the main game, the DLC is loosely based on stories and events written by Tove Jansson, but with our own twist and interpretations to make it into a story that works well  for a video game. Fuddler and this specific story from the comics has been one of our favorites, but we struggled to find a good way to include it within the main story. It was really hard for us to let it go, so when the main game was finished, we started playing with the exciting idea of having it added as a small addition to the game as a sort of epilogue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/88659c48939ca20bb5fa34de6390c02c58c1a913.png[/img]

For Fuddler, expressing his feelings is overwhelming - especially when he’s in the presence of Mymble. All matters of the heart aren’t easy, and finding the right combination of words and actions to convey what’s stirring in your soul requires bravery and a willingness to present your most vulnerable insides for inspection. But Fuddler isn’t alone! He has friends by his side, and when playing as Snufkin, hopefully that includes you too💚

notes.title: This heartfelt novella-like story arrives Dec 17th!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

Love is in the crispy autumn air! Join Snufkin as he gives newfound friend Fuddler a helping hand through a blossoming romance in the upcoming [b]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley: Fuddler’s Courtship[/b] DLC, releasing on Steam and consoles this December 17th.  

[previewyoutube=vtWcmTV-tRQ;full][/previewyoutube]
In the new novella-like story of budding love and friendship, Snufkin and his best pal Moomintroll embark on a final camping trip before the onset of winter. 

However, the far reaches of Moominvalley’s wilds hold more adventure and surprises of the heart than either of the two could have imagined. 

What should have been a relaxing excursion in an enchanting autumn-turning nature transforms into a chaotic, love-infused journey with many new and old friends alike! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875880/Snufkin_Melody_of_Moominvalley__Fuddlers_Courtship/

[h2][b]Key Features[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Gone camping:[/b] Once again, Moominvalley’s friends and family find themselves in need of Snufkin and his best pal, Moomintroll. Head out on a love-filled adventure with a cast of your favorite characters, and make new friends on a journey sprinkled with puzzles, surprises, and enchanting musical notes.
[*][b]Pushing the right buttons:[/b] Meet the charming yet shy Fuddler and help him on a journey of the heart, exploring the complexities of love and romance as he courts Mymble, Little My’s sister.
[*][b]Something’s in the air:[/b] Nature changes color as Moominvalley welcomes autumn in all its splendor. Witness the rich spectacle of nature beautifully recreated in this atmospheric [i]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley[/i] expansion. 
[/list]
[b]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley: Fuddler’s Courtship[/b] is a brand-new pocket-sized musical adventure filled with wonderful encounters, puzzles, and characters, set amongst Moominvalley’s striking watercolor visuals of autumn. 

[h2]🍂Fall🍂 into Moominvalley’s Autumn[/h2]

Every season has its pace, and autumn invites slowing down. It’s the time to breathe in the brisk air,  wrap your palms around warm mugs of tea, and cozy up on the couch with a journal or… a lovely little game called Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/f41bb60cc88e645f3f3919cc050a26469a59496b.jpg[/img]

It just so happens that autumn has also swept into Moominvalley! In our Snufkin game’s new DLC, Fuddler’s Courtship, the forests rustle with colorful leaves and a beautiful melancholy unique to fall. Wander in this charming storybook-like world, taking a moment to admire a particularly delightful blade of grass or swaying tree. And we hope the painting-like fall landscape in our Snufkin game offers many serene and calm viewing spots to note a lovely autumn leaf or two. 

Fuddler’s Courtship is a pocket-sized adventure bursting at the seams with a larger-than-life emotion: love. Join Snufkin and his best friend, Moomintroll, as they befriend Fuddler and assist him in the delicate matters of the heart  — winning over his beloved Mymble. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/f88c0a3f222553fcc0158d6c16d902eccd86bc27.png[/img]

Some may view autumn with trepidation, as it slides so easily into gloomy winter. But as Tove Jansson writes in Moominvalley in November, “The quiet transition from autumn to winter is not a bad time at all.” It’s the season to find what keeps the internal hearth stoked and what you can rely on when the world goes quiet. We hope in Fuddler’s Courtship you’ll find a similar respite in the warmth of new and old friendships, plus unexpected adventures — all set against the gentle pace of autumn, the final season before winter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/534abc7fec460e41ae7afe341380f4c81a232126.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 💚Thank you so much for your love💚
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/dcabd8e674da8b21a95d984d8ce3e0a487332b84.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thank You![/h2]
It has absolutely warmed our hearts to see wanderers enjoying their travels in Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley! We’ve worked on this game for four years, and it feels indescribable to finally see everybody play in and explore the world we’ve worked hard to build. Thank you so much for the lovely comments, the excitement, and all the support everybody has shown our Snufkin game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/871a27c566c93ba17e549155c3352493fb818331.gif[/img]

[h2]We are excited for all the positive feedback[/h2]
Wow!! We can’t believe all the wonderful reviews and comments we’ve received from both players and critics! We’re really glad players have enjoyed stealthily sneaking past police officers and exploring the watercolour landscapes - especially the sightseeing vistas, like Snufkin fishing or looking up at the bright blue sky. We’ve received much feedback about the appreciation of those small special moments in the game, and we love reading it all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/186e4642bf4ee68651edaf8ff9c0cfb3c6b8ab59.png[/img]
[h2]Please review the game on Steam! It helps us, indie developers, more than you can imagine[/h2]

If you enjoyed playing Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, we would appreciate it if you could review the game. It would mean a tremendous amount to us. Reviews help boost the visibility of our game on platforms and improve discoverability, which means more friends, family and future fans have the opportunity to find and experience our Snufkin game. In turn, this lets us continue to work on and develop it. Thank you in advance! It means a great deal to us✨

To leave a review, check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808680/Snufkin_Melody_of_Moominvalley/]Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley Steam page[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/f26c6347decf941e5f5a8d87c61fc35d9f46c5a8.png[/img]
[h2]Thank you for your feedback and reporting! A patch is in the works[/h2]

Throughout the past few days, we have identified a couple of areas for improvement and received reports on issues that we are working to resolve. We are currently working on a patch to be delivered in the near future, addressing several things:

[b]Nintendo Switch:[/b]

[list]

[*] Updated the game icon
[*] Updated video compression settings for Switch for smoother playback
[*] Fixed a number of minor visual glitches
[*] Fixed the issue where language select didn't work with touch
[*] Fixed a few softlock issues
[/list]
[b]Steam:[/b]

[list]
[*] Resolved a game resolution issue on PC
[*] Added windowed mode
[*] Fixed a few softlock issues
[/list]

To report bugs, please submit them at the [url=https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]Raw Fury support site[/url]!

[/list]
All pre-purchases, whether you get the base game or the Digital Deluxe edition, come with a 10% discount! For info on what’s included in the Digital Deluxe edition, check out our full breakdown below.

[h2]✨Digital Deluxe edition breakdown✨[/h2]

The digital deluxe edition contains:
[list]
[*] Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
[*] The cosmetic Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley Cherished Keepsakes DLC 
[*] The Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley Digital Original Soundtrack
[*] The Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley Digital Artbook 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/e8a773a3739615e16941e1e81f39aecd6406edc3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Cherished Keepsakes DLC🍀[/h3]
The Cherished Keepsakes DLC is a cosmetic DLC that includes two of Snufkin’s beloved mementos: blooming flowers for Snufkin’s hat and a wooden mouthpiece for when Snufkin is lost in thought!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/3c0d64de1d0cb3521a0dcc75eb76c0a95799db8c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Digital Artbook🎨[/h3]
The digital artbook contains over 230 pages of lush and beautiful art behind Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, including never-before-seen places and environment. Players will also find info on the journey in making the game and get a behind-the-curtain look on the techniques, philosophy, and styles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/409e763088290f0eb0ef0a0cafd6797a83c94d58.jpg[/img]

[h3]Digital Soundtrack 🎶[/h3]
The official soundtrack of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley is an atmospheric and relaxing 25-track collaboration between the composer Oda Tilset and the famous Icelandic band Sigur Rós! Inspired by stunning views of nature and Nordic landscapes, the melodies born in the hands and hearts of Sigur Rós and Tilset contribute to Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley’s enchanting appeal. 

From the playful clarinets and flute that bounce off each other in the Fillyjonk’s garden to the more contemplative and spacious mood characterizing exploration in the wild country - Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley’s soundtrack is a delightful accompaniment to players’ winding journeys through the valley. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/e989473c05fc75b495c2bf752b0dd06cb01e0197.jpg[/img]

[h2]Will there be a physical edition? 🤔[/h2]
We’ve been asked a lot whether there will be a Nintendo Switch physical edition. We are planning to launch a Nintendo Switch physical edition in Japan later this year! 
We are continuously investigating additional options of distributing Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley both digitally and physically. We will share news when we have them!

[h2]A reminder for creators!💚 [/h2]
Please remember to turn on the creator mode, if you’re streaming our game! We want to make sure it's a flawless experience for you and your audience. 

You can do so by going to "Settings,” which can be accessed both from the Main Menu and the Pause Menu. Enable or disable the Streamer Mode by checking the box as seen in this screenshot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/5c5f4b15ce083c2a5d94c8710e84f25daaa78a4b.jpg[/img]
[h2]See you soon! 🏕️[/h2]
We hope you walk with us as Snufkin to Moominvalley! Marvel at spring wildflowers and cute ducklings, play melodies for curious critters, and sneakily get rid of parks against all odds. Snufkin may just be one person dodging Police Officers, hiding from their line of sight, and plucking signs - but he’ll encounter many quirky and loveable friends on his travels who support him and who he supports in return. 

We can’t wait to embark on the journey with everyone on March 7!
